description: `platformAutomerge` hands the merge of an automerging PR to GitHub's native auto-merge, which lands it the moment the Protect Main ruleset's required checks pass, instead of on Renovate's next run (about hourly). Safe because the required set builds, tests and renders previews (yschimke/renovate-config repo-policy: Assemble, Unit tests and Render previews); native auto-merge waits only on required checks, so it would not be safe on a repository whose ruleset required nothing.

packageRules.description: Gradle patch and minor updates wait for a person here: the shared preset auto-lands them once CI is green, but this repository has always kept dependency bumps that reach the app build manual.

Published ee.schimke.composeai modules are versionless and resolve through their release-train BOMs. Keep module-level coordinates disabled; the BOM rules below re-enable each train's BOM on its own release line.

compose-ai-tools ships the preview CLI, the ee.schimke.composeai.preview Gradle plugin and the reusable CI composite actions as a single release. Track it aggressively so CI always runs the latest renderer: no weekly-window wait, and automerge minor/patch updates as soon as CI is green.
Update compose-preview-daemon-bom on its own 3.x release line; preview-annotations takes its version from its constraints.
Update Livery (livery-bom, the liveryCatalog Gradle plugin and reusable catalog workflows) together on its 0.x release line.
Re-enable patch/minor automerge for the compose-ai-tools, compose-preview-daemon and livery trains after the repository-wide manual Gradle rule above; majors remain manual.

Offline Robolectric tests select API 35 with @Config. android-all-instrumented is an exact platform/provider image, not a library upgrade: replacing Android 15's jar with Android 17 removes the SDK Robolectric requests. Keep the catalog's SDK 35 pin until the test SDK and Robolectric provider change together.

Remote Compose, its Wear widget layer, Glance Wear and rc-players-bom must move together — `remote-material3` and `glance-wear` both declare `androidx.compose.remote:remote-creation*` in their POMs, and a skewed set fails compilation or preview render — so group them into ONE PR.
